instruction: you begin facing a cabinet, turn to your left and you will see an open glass door, go towards it, and then look slightly to your left and stand behind the couch that's in front of you, then look to your left again and stand between the brown l-shaped couch and the dresser on the right with a mirror on top of it, and then looking forward, you will see some stools in the kitchen, stand behind the stools, stand between the kitchen island and the kitchen cabinets, and then turn back around and take a step towards the right side of the pillar in front of you, staying on the tiled floor, walk forward, go through the archway in front of you and then turn to the right, you will enter a laundry room, take one step into the room and you're done.
